name: Mou Hitotsu no Mizu no Kioku
original_name: もうひとつの水の記憶
source:
The protagonist Minakami Rima enrolls into a new school to escape her harsh past.
But there she meets Takano Ryou who knows her past and an old friend Morimura Tooru.
She also meets two student council members Hasumi and Asakura.
What will she gain from these meetings?
Will she bury the past? Find the beginning of love? Find a new reason for living? Or...
translation:
主人公水上梨真为了逃避残酷的过去而进入了新学校。
但在那里，她遇到了了解她过去的高野亮和老朋友森村透。
她还见到了两名学生会成员莲见和朝仓。
她将从这些会议中得到什么？
她会埋葬过去吗？找到爱情的开始？寻找新的生活理由？或者…
